question.text: Which of the following developments created a new space for special situation funds in India?

answer.text: Introduction of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code 2016

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook states that the introduction of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 created a new space for special situation funds. Other workbook sections describe SSFs investing in special situation assets including distressed assets and acting as resolution applicants under the IBC. The Trap: GST, demonetisation and Digital India did not create the specific framework that opened up the special-situation-fund opportunity; the workbook attributes that to the IBC. Note: Limit the explanation to the IBC link, the special-situation-asset focus, and the resolution-applicant capacity that the workbook supports.
